chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Muhammad ibn Isa ibn Ubayd, from Yunus, from Is'haq ibn Ammar, from Abu Basir who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'The woman is buried up to her waist when they intend to stone her, and the Imam pelts first, then the people afterwards, with small stones.'

key_terms.أَحْجَارٍ صِغَارٍ: Small stones — specifying the size of stones used, a jurisprudential detail
key_terms.الْإِمَامُ: The Imam — the legitimate authority who initiates the execution
key_terms.الْمَرْأَةُ: The woman — indicating this ruling applies specifically to female offenders
key_terms.تُدْفَنُ: Is buried (in the earth) — specifying partial burial as a procedural requirement
key_terms.يَرْجُمُوهَا: To stone her — from rajm, the prescribed hadd punishment for adultery

ai.seo_question: What is the Islamic ruling on how stoning (rajm) is carried out for a woman?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) describes the prescribed procedure for rajm (stoning) when applied to a woman. The ruling specifies that she be buried up to her waist to preserve her modesty, that the Imam initiates the stoning, and that small stones be used. This ruling is part of the Shia jurisprudential elaboration of hudud punishments, specifying the procedural details that distinguish the application of this penalty from arbitrary violence.
